$comment: Ryan OS Asset Registry. The authoritative directory of operational resources. An agent consults this BEFORE searching anywhere else - see ../governance/RESOURCE_DISCOVERY.md. Entries with status 'gap' are resources Ryan OS knows should exist but has no authoritative version for; they are here on purpose so the gap is visible instead of silently filled with the wrong file.

assets.name: Woods Forms App
assets.what_it_is: The internal Flask web app that hosts every WCS operational form and generates their PDFs. Runs locally on port 5001.

where_it_is.detail: Launch with START_APP.bat on Windows, or `python3 app.py`. Opens http://localhost:5001 automatically.

assets.use_when: Any time a WCS form needs to be filled out and turned into a PDF, or a bid turnover needs to be generated without a terminal.

assets.name: Bid Turnover Decision Engine
assets.what_it_is: The governed engine that converts an inbound bid request into the internal LOAD AND BID NEEDED turnover email, applying equipment, margin, system count, options, and confidence rules.

where_it_is.detail: Run via `python3 ryan-os/cli/turnover.py intake.json`, the /bid-turnover page in the Woods Forms App, or the bid-turnover skill.

assets.use_when: A new HVAC bid request arrives and needs to be turned over to estimating.
assets.do_not_use_when: The work is outside residential new construction - the engine escalates rather than guessing.

assets.name: Ryan OS Governed Defaults
assets.what_it_is: The single source of truth for margin defaults, equipment defaults, pricing profiles, the always-include option list, escalation triggers, and turnover recipients.
assets.use_when: Any time a governed value is needed. Read it - never recall a margin or an equipment default from memory.
assets.do_not_use_when: Never restate these values in a prompt or a skill. Point at this file instead.

assets.name: Ryan OS Builder Library
assets.what_it_is: One JSON profile per builder recording their classification, contracted margin, standard equipment, jurisdiction, option exclusions, and standing instructions. Overrides the governed defaults.
assets.use_when: Any time a decision depends on who the builder is - margin, equipment, permits, options.
assets.notes: Currently sparse. Every profile added converts MEDIUM assumptions to HIGH.

assets.name: Load Calculation Request Form (Bid Info Sheet)
assets.what_it_is: The detailed Manual J request form - construction specs, envelope, equipment preference, ventilation, IAQ, returns, and permit fields. Generates a PDF for the design team.
assets.use_when: A Manual J load calculation needs to be requested with full construction detail.
assets.do_not_use_when: For turning over an inbound builder email, use the Bid Turnover engine instead - it is faster and applies governed defaults.

assets.name: QuickBid / HVAC Bid Proposal
assets.what_it_is: The customer-facing HVAC proposal generator. QuickBid captures costs, burdens, and margin, then produces the branded bid proposal PDF with equipment options.

where_it_is.detail: Woods Forms App route /quick-bid; posts to /generate-bid-proposal-pdf

assets.use_when: A priced proposal needs to go to a builder or homeowner.

assets.name: HVAC Bid Sheet (Legacy)
assets.what_it_is: The original HVAC bid sheet and its PDF generator, kept for older jobs.
assets.use_when: Only for continuity on jobs already bid on this sheet.
assets.notes: Labelled 'Legacy' in the app's own navigation. Confirm with Ryan before retiring it entirely.

assets.name: New Construction Scheduling Dispatch
assets.what_it_is: Schedules rough-in and other installation visits and captures GC superintendent coordination details.
assets.use_when: An installation or site visit needs to be scheduled and dispatched.

assets.name: Special Order Request Form
assets.what_it_is: Requests equipment or material that is not stock.
assets.use_when: Non-stock equipment or material has to be ordered for a job.

assets.name: Changes / Upgrades / Additions Form
assets.what_it_is: Captures scope changes, upgrades, and additions to an existing job.
assets.use_when: Scope changes after the original bid.
assets.notes: Overlaps with the Additional Work form. Ryan should confirm which is authoritative for which situation.

assets.name: Additional Work Order Form
assets.what_it_is: Authorizes and documents additional work beyond the contracted scope.
assets.use_when: Work outside the original contract needs authorization and a paper trail.

assets.name: Design Plan Walk Sheet
assets.what_it_is: The on-site design walk checklist used to capture field conditions and design decisions.
assets.use_when: Walking a house for design before or during rough-in.

assets.name: Linear Grille Order Form
assets.what_it_is: Orders linear and decorative grilles with sizing and finish detail.
assets.use_when: Linear or decorative grilles need to be ordered for a job.

assets.name: Linear Grille Order - Portable HTML
assets.what_it_is: A standalone single-file HTML version of the linear grille order form that works without the Flask app running.

where_it_is.detail: Open the file directly in a browser - no server needed.

assets.use_when: Offline or on a machine that does not have the Woods Forms App running.
assets.notes: DECISION NEEDED: this duplicates form-linear-grille-order. Ryan should declare one authoritative for in-office use and keep this one scoped to offline use, or retire it. Flagged rather than silently preferred.

assets.name: HVAC Equipment Schedule Template
assets.what_it_is: The standardized, drawing-ready HVAC equipment schedule spreadsheet placed on plans, plus the standards document that governs its format.

where_it_is.detail: Ships with the hvac-equipment-schedule skill. Standards: references/HVAC_Schedule_Standards.md in the same folder.

assets.use_when: An equipment schedule needs to go on plans, or an existing schedule needs to be standardized.
assets.notes: PORTABILITY GAP: this lives in a machine-local skills folder, not in a shared location. If Ryan's machine is rebuilt it is gone, and no one else can reach it. Recommend moving it to a Drive location and registering that path here.

assets.name: bid-turnover skill
assets.what_it_is: The Claude skill that runs the Bid Turnover Decision Engine on an inbound request.

where_it_is.detail: Auto-triggers in Claude sessions in this repository.

assets.use_when: Asking Claude to turn over a bid request.

assets.name: wcs-bid-request skill
assets.what_it_is: The original skill that generated a load-and-bid email from Ryan's dictated notes, using 34% custom / 18% production margins.
assets.use_when: Only when Ryan is dictating a job from scratch with no inbound email to process.
assets.do_not_use_when: Any inbound builder request - its margin rules are superseded. See DECISION_LOG ADR-002.

assets.name: Operations Orchestrator Prompts
assets.what_it_is: The portable system and task prompts that make Codex, ChatGPT, and other agents behave like the Operations Orchestrator.
assets.use_when: Setting up any non-Claude agent to run Ryan OS work.

assets.name: Bid Turnover Playbook
assets.what_it_is: The step-by-step runbook for processing an inbound bid request end to end.
assets.use_when: Executing or reviewing the turnover process.

assets.name: Email Classification Playbook
assets.what_it_is: The triage rules for routing an inbound Outlook message: bid request, bid update, Manual J complete, bid complete, scheduling, vendor, noise, or uncertain.
assets.use_when: Deciding what an inbound email is and where it goes.

assets.name: Orchestrator Loop Playbook
assets.what_it_is: The full Operations Orchestrator loop, marking what is built versus what is still Phase 2 or 3.
assets.use_when: Understanding what the Orchestrator does today and what is not built yet.

assets.name: Ryan OS Governance
assets.what_it_is: The rules for what may change, who approves it, and how agents must behave. Includes the escalation policy, confidence framework, resource discovery rule, and decision log.
assets.use_when: Before changing any governed value, and any time an agent is unsure whether it is allowed to do something.

assets.name: Ryan OS Asset Registry
assets.what_it_is: This registry - the authoritative directory of operational resources. Answers where the right version of anything lives.

where_it_is.detail: Query with `python3 ryan-os/cli/asset.py find "<what you need>"`.

assets.use_when: ALWAYS, before searching for any work-related resource. This is the first stop, not the fallback.
assets.do_not_use_when: Never bypass it by searching the filesystem or Drive first - see ryan-os/governance/RESOURCE_DISCOVERY.md.

assets.name: Builder Profile CLI
assets.what_it_is: Command-line tool that proposes a governed classification for an unknown builder and creates a pre-populated Builder Profile from it.
assets.use_when: A bid request arrives from a builder with no profile on file.

assets.name: Equipment & Labor Pricing Workbook
assets.what_it_is: The authoritative source for equipment costs, labor rates, and burden percentages that estimating prices against.

where_it_is.detail: Not registered. Ryan OS does not know where the current pricing lives.

assets.use_when: Pricing any bid.
assets.gap_recommendation: Register the authoritative pricing workbook - file path or Drive location, who updates it, and how often. Until this exists, every agent that needs a cost is guessing or asking. This is the highest-impact gap in the registry.

assets.name: Job Folder Template
assets.what_it_is: The standard folder structure created for every new job, and where jobs live once created.
assets.use_when: Starting a new job and needing somewhere to put plans, the Manual J, and the bid.
assets.gap_recommendation: Register the job folder root (server or Drive) and the template structure. Without it, agents cannot file or retrieve job documents, and the turnover email can only reference attachments rather than a job folder.

assets.name: Google Drive - Operational Root
assets.what_it_is: The Drive folder that holds shared operational documents - templates, plans, proposals.

where_it_is.detail: Not registered. A Drive connector is available to Ryan OS but no authoritative folder has been declared.

assets.use_when: Reading or filing any shared document.
assets.gap_recommendation: Declare which Drive folders are authoritative for which document types. A connected Drive without a registered root means an agent searching it may find three versions of a template and no way to tell which one is current - exactly what the Resource Discovery Rule exists to prevent.

assets.name: Office Server / Network Share
assets.what_it_is: The office file server or network share holding job files and archives.
assets.use_when: Retrieving archived job files or shared office documents.
assets.gap_recommendation: Register the UNC path or mapped drive letter and what lives there. If there is no server and everything is on Drive, record that instead so agents stop treating it as an open question.

assets.name: Manual J Software & Output Location
assets.what_it_is: The load calculation software the design team uses, and where completed Manual J reports are filed.
assets.use_when: Running or retrieving a Manual J.
assets.gap_recommendation: Register the software (e.g. Wrightsoft / Elite / cove.tool) and where completed reports are saved. Phase 2 job tracking will need to confirm a Manual J is genuinely complete, not just that someone replied saying so.

assets.name: Outlook - Operations Mailbox
assets.what_it_is: The mailbox the Operations Orchestrator monitors for new work.

where_it_is.detail: Ryan's desktop Outlook. No account, folder, or rule set is registered.

assets.use_when: Detecting new bid requests and tracking Manual J / bid completion replies.
assets.gap_recommendation: Register which mailbox and which folders the Orchestrator watches, and whether a rule pre-sorts bid requests. Needed before Phase 2 automatic detection can be built.
